reasons: Paired room-only SI-SDR improves for both speakers
No unchanged-threshold watchdog warnings against clean or room input, with shared clean speech eligibility
No additional non-orthographic ASR error introduced by model in saved controls
Native sample counts, measured lag/drift, clipping and true peaks are intact
caveats: Untreated synthetic room also has zero watchdog warnings; warnings do not measure dryness
Shared simple synthetic room is not Finnegan lecture-theatre ground truth
Clean recordings are not asserted perfectly anechoic
ASR and acoustic proxies cannot certify natural consonants/identity
Matched control listening remains available; no human listening success is claimed
